This creates a tangible, high-profile catalyst that could re-rate Tesla's stock as investors reassess the combined Musk empire. A 3% position captures this speculative upside while limiting risk to acceptable levels given TSLA's volatility.

No prior trade on SLV means no reversal constraint.
